Good questions

A few useful answers.

Open the details you need.

How much budget do I need?

It depends on your industry and city, since cost-per-click varies. Most small businesses start with a modest monthly budget and scale up once they see which campaigns bring results. We'll figure out a realistic number together.

Will I own my account?

Yes. The Google Ads account is set up under your own business, and you have full access to it at all times, including if we ever stop working together.

Do you guarantee sales?

No one can honestly guarantee sales, since that also depends on your offer, pricing, and follow-up. What I can commit to is a properly built, well-managed campaign focused on qualified leads.
